THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics and Critical Review

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to appraise intention-to-treat analysis, missing data handling and meta-analysis for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Explain intention-to-treat analysis and compare it with per-protocol analysis.
  2. Describe data missing completely at random, at random and not at random, and methods such as multiple imputation and last observation carried forward.
  3. Explain the purpose of meta-analysis and interpret a forest plot.
  4. Compare fixed-effect and random-effects models of meta-analysis.
  5. Interpret heterogeneity using Cochran's Q and the I-squared statistic.
  6. Interpret funnel plots for publication bias and describe sensitivity analysis.
  7. Answer the chapter's 89 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
